funding.label: Council tax
funding.desc: What residents pay through the council's part of the bill

funding.label: Revenue Support Grant
funding.desc: The council's main general grant from government. From 2026/27 it includes funding that used to come through business rates and separate grants

funding.label: Business rates kept locally
funding.official_term: Retained income from Rate Retention Scheme
funding.desc: The share of local business rates the council keeps

funding.label: Schools grants (ring-fenced)
funding.official_term: Dedicated Schools Grant and other education grants
funding.desc: Passed to schools; cannot be spent on anything else

funding.label: Public health grant (ring-fenced)
funding.desc: Can only be spent on public health

funding.label: Other government grants
funding.official_term: Other specific and special grants within AEF
funding.desc: Grants for adult care, children and families, homelessness and others, including the income protection floor

detail.label: Other grants within AEF (enter in rows 801 - 898 below)
Homelessness, Rough Sleeping and Domestic Abuse Grant
Families First Partnership (within Children, Families and Youth Grant)
Other Children, Families and Youth Grant

funding.label: Council tax surplus and other
funding.official_term: Collection fund surplus and other items
funding.desc: Last year's council tax collected above estimate, and other items

funding.label: Drawn from council reserves
funding.official_term: Appropriations from earmarked and unallocated reserves
funding.desc: One-off: once spent, the gap returns the year after

services.label: Schools and education
services.desc: Schools' budgets, paid by ring-fenced government grants, plus education the council pays for itself such as special needs transport
services.method_note: Net current expenditure, RA 2026-27 lines 110, 120, 130, 140, 145, 165, grouped by Borough Book (data/manual/ra_service_map.csv).

services.label: Care for older and disabled adults
services.desc: Home care, care homes and support for disabled adults
services.method_note: Net current expenditure, RA 2026-27 lines 332, 333, 340, 344, 353, 354, 355, 356, grouped by Borough Book (data/manual/ra_service_map.csv).

services.label: Children's services

services.label: Housing and homelessness

services.label: Public health

services.method_note: Net current expenditure, RA 2026-27 lines 361, 363, 365, 372, 376, 383, 384, 389, grouped by Borough Book (data/manual/ra_service_map.csv).

services.label: Running the council
